entities.summary: Hieronymus Heyerdahl was a Norwegian lawyer, administrator and politician for the Conservative Party. He served as mayor of Oslo and was associated with the development of the new Oslo City Hall. Hieronymus Heyerdahl was a legal figures from Fredrikstad Municipality (1867-05-05, Fredrikstad Municipality–1959-01-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
